intro.title: Touching the Future
intro.subtitle: CAPI CAREER PATH SIMULATOR
intro.blurb: Capi will scan your way of thinking through 15 quick questions, drop you into a 20-question simulation mission, and decode your Capi-Gene — your career signature.
intro.new_title: You have been summoned to the Capi Research Institute
intro.new_blurb: Welcome to the Capi Research Institute! I am Capi, your assistant. Before stepping into the virtual reality simulation gates, let me run a preliminary scan on your thinking system. Ready?
intro.footer_hint: Complete the first scan to unlock virtual reality simulation gates.
intro.scan_intro_blurb: You will answer 15 questions on a 1-5 scale. Please choose based on what you actually do, not what you think is the "correct choice".
intro.login_modal_desc: Log in to save your test results and review them anytime!
intro.hero_blurb: These are real-world situations in the STEAM domain, where you freely make intuitive decisions to identify your unique career potential and core strengths.
intro.sec2_subtitle: Capi Career does not give you theoretical questions. Instead, you experience a process where Capi deconstructs and analyzes each "Career DNA" code within you:
intro.card1_quote: “Who do you consider yourself to be? A pioneer always eager to explore, or a cautious strategist calculating every single move?”
intro.card1_desc: This is a mirror reflecting how you currently perceive yourself.
intro.card2_quote: “When situations arise, how do you act and think? Do you decide swiftly or weigh options with meticulous care?”
intro.card2_desc: Every decision you make reflects how you handle situations and interact with the world.
intro.card3_quote: “After the experience, looking back, do you see a new perspective? Do you realize you are “different from what you thought”, or “undeniably yourself”?”
intro.card3_desc: Looking back across the entire journey to see if your initial perspective shifted.
intro.sec2_callout_desc: There is no single perfect answer! The real insight lies in the gap between thought and reality: Who do you think you are, and how do you actually act in real life?
intro.sec3_subtitle: Which DNA is dormant within you? Explore the 5 special pieces that determine how you react, think, and act:
intro.sec3_callout_desc: Each of us carries all 5 of these DNA codes. Capi Gene is an ecosystem that helps you see yourself more clearly. Do not box yourself in, as this is a lens to understand how your natural tendencies emerge in your working style and problem-solving.
intro.sec4_title: Ready to discover your Capi Gene?
intro.sec4_step1_desc: No two people are alike, and there are no cookie-cutter answers. Every choice is a unique brushstroke of you.
intro.sec4_step2_desc: Every decision reveals a valuable aspect of your thinking mindset.
intro.sec4_step3_desc: Don't overthink! Your immediate reaction is always the most honest answer about who you are.
intro.sec4_note: All three DNA codes are the "keys" that help you understand yourself and discover your true strengths.
